title: Keyturn Roadside Assistance Benefit Schedule: Replacement Vehicle, Trip Interruption and Overnight Cover
content:
## Allowances carried beyond the roadside

Alongside the assistance given at the vehicle, a Keyturn Roadside Assistance plan may provide a
replacement vehicle with a daily allowance toward it, cover for a trip cut short by a breakdown, and
cover for a night away from home after a breakdown. The schedule below states each figure plan by plan.

| Plan | A replacement vehicle is provided | Daily allowance toward a replacement vehicle (USD) | Cover for a trip cut short by a breakdown (USD) | Cover for a night away from home after a breakdown (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover | no | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover | no | 0.00 | 150.00 | 0.00 |
| Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover | no | 0.00 | 250.00 | 150.00 |
| Keyturn Roadside EV Cover | no | 0.00 | 250.00 | 150.00 |
| Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover | yes | 55.00 | 400.00 | 200.00 |
| Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover | yes | 120.00 | 750.00 | 350.00 |

### Notes on the schedule

1. A replacement vehicle is provided on Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover and Keyturn Roadside Concierge
   Cover alone, with a daily allowance of USD 55.00 and USD 120.00 respectively. On the other four
   plans no replacement vehicle is provided and the daily allowance stands at USD 0.00.
2. Cover for a trip cut short by a breakdown stands at USD 0.00 on Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover and
   rises through USD 150.00 on Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover, USD 250.00 on Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover
   and Keyturn Roadside EV Cover and USD 400.00 on Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover to USD 750.00 on
   Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover.
3. Cover for a night away from home stands at USD 0.00 on Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover and Keyturn
   Roadside Plus Cover, at USD 150.00 on Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover and Keyturn Roadside EV Cover, at
   USD 200.00 on Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover and at USD 350.00 on Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover.
